blocks.text: يوتن دونیا تشجیله ری، برله شگر

translations.en: One person illuminates the world, but the other is sugar.

blocks.text: ر. ك . په که کروچی نشچیلدر نه ریسه بلرگه تییش.

translations.en: R. K. If you don't get a good deal, you won't get a good deal.
I also like the look of it.

blocks.text: س س ر حالقلاری گوزه ك نه شریباتی مه سکه و - 1924 يل.

translations.en: The current goldsmith's shop is not a silversmith's shop - 1924.
